hooks.comment: Marketplace-dev hook. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same hook for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; both paths are safe because the script is idempotent.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Advisory: warns when an edit to a plugin agent file looks like the agent is instructing itself to spawn a sub-agent. This is a PostToolUse hook, so it CANNOT block/undo the edit; RC_GUARD_RECURSIVE_SPAWN_STRICT=1 surfaces it as a post-edit error, not a hard block.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Advisory (Claim Grounding & Source Honesty): nudges on an unhedged absolute capability claim written into a knowledge/ or docs/ markdown file without a provenance marker. Opt-in, skips frontmatter/code/blockquotes/headings/conditionals, honors `claim-lint-ok`. Exit 0 always.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Advisory (Capability Grounding — consult-your-access-inventory): nudges on a 'tell the user to manually check / open the portal' phrasing written into a knowledge/ or docs/ markdown file. Opt-in, skips frontmatter/code/blockquotes/headings, suppresses a hand-back reason or a line citing the held route, honors `delegation-nudge-ok`. Exit 0 always; cannot see the chat answer (written-artifact subset only).

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). When a plugin.json or marketplace.json version changes inside this marketplace clone, regenerates the Copilot package + dashboard.html + repo-guide.html — the artifacts CI freshness gates check. No-op on non-manifest edits and when version is unchanged.

Marketplace-dev mirror of the plugin's PostToolUse WebFetch entry. Records the per-session 'seen' marker for a whitelisted domain ONLY after the fetch actually proceeded (PostToolUse doesn't fire on a blocked call) — the consent-ordering complement to guard-web-access.sh so a denied first fetch re-prompts instead of silently auto-allowing. Fail-safe; never blocks.
Marketplace-dev mirror of the plugin's PostToolUse WebFetch sanitizer (v0.266.0). Rewrites the fetched body via updatedToolOutput. Fail-open; WebFetch only.
Block obviously destructive commands that slipped past the deny list. Reads the tool call as JSON on stdin; exits 2 to block (exit 1 would not block).

Marketplace-dev hook. Command review (the Thing) — T3 panel tribunal. No-ops (fast grep) unless a category has `thing: on` in .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml. The internal panel deadline (~75s) stays under this 90s hook timeout. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; both paths are safe because the script is idempotent and short-circuits when no toggle is set.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Runaway/rabbit-hole brake — portable replacement for native auto-mode's 3/20 brake. No-ops unless .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml exists (this repo has none, so it no-ops); exits 2 when the agent thrashes (default 8 identical calls in a row) or blows a total-call ceiling (default 200). Deterministic, no model.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json PreToolUse(Bash) entry). Probe-validity advisory (default WARN, and WARN is the ONLY verdict). Reads the `probe_validity: off|warn` knob from .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml (this repo dogfoods `probe_validity: warn`); an ABSENT posture file is a no-op. ONE rule: `grep -v` used in QUIET MODE, where the exit status stops answering "is there a line that does NOT match?" and starts reporting whether the PATTERN is ABSENT — an inverted answer that reads as clean. Quiet is entered two ways: a -q/--quiet/--silent flag (possibly bundled: -qv, -vq, -rqv, -qvE), and stdout redirected to /dev/null SPECIFICALLY (no -q required). ⛔ No host probe and no deny path, deliberately — a hook-side probe measures the wrong shell's grep, which makes a probe-gated deny branch unreachable in production and testable-green. Never exits 2. Same script the plugin distributes to consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json PreToolUse(Bash) entry). Git-protocol nudge (default WARN): no-ops unless .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml is present (this repo has none, so it no-ops), then reads the `git_protocol: off|warn|block` knob (default warn). WARNs on a non-Conventional-Commits `git commit -m` subject or a new-branch creation off the (feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|agent)/ prefix convention; BLOCKS (exit 2) only when the knob is `block`. A direct non-force push to main/master is advisory-only and NEVER blocks. Does NOT touch force operations / branch force-delete / recursive-remove / hard reset (guard-destructive.sh owns those). Fail-open on any error / missing git / missing python3 / absent posture. Same script the plugin distributes to consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
Layout enforcement: deny writes that don't match .repo-layout.json. Same script the plugin distributes to consumers.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json PreToolUse entry). Worktree-hygiene guard (check): reads `worktree_guard: off|warn|block` from .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml (default warn; this repo dogfoods `worktree_guard: warn`, so it nudges but never blocks). On `block` DENIES (exit 2) ONLY a mutating op (git commit/add/checkout/switch/merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert/stash/rm/mv, or a Write/Edit/MultiEdit under the tree) when another live session shares this working tree or this is anchor-work — never a read / git status / rcwt. Escape hatch: RC_WORKTREE_GUARD_ACK=1. `off` short-circuits before any git shell-out; fail-open on missing git/jq. Same script the plugin distributes to consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.

Marketplace-dev mirror of the plugin's WebFetch entry. Website allow/deny enforcement: whitelisted domain auto-allows, blacklisted blocks (exit 2), unlisted falls through to the prompt. Reads .ravenclaude/web-access.yaml; no-ops if absent.

Marketplace-dev hook. Decision-review enforcement (the Thing, decision mode). No-ops (fast grep) unless `decision_review: advisory|binding` is set in .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml (default off; this repo has no such file so it no-ops). When opted in AND the AskUserQuestion is a single binary non-multiselect yes/no-shaped question, routes it through thing-decide.py and on a BINDING yes/no DENIES the prompt with the verdict so the agent proceeds without interrupting the user; defer/advisory/high-blast/error -> allow. Same script the plugin distributes to consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
Marketplace-dev mirror of the plugin's Phase 6 cause-closure gate.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Definition-of-done gate: no-ops unless definition_of_done.cmd is set in .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml (this repo has none, so it no-ops). When set + source changed, runs the gate command at Stop and blocks until it passes (self-limited to max_blocks). Closes the correctness/hallucination gap.
Remind the Team Lead to run the full test suite when source files changed. Advisory fallback when no definition_of_done.cmd is configured.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Agentic Work-Streams (P1): on session end, if a work-stream is active in .ravenclaude/streams/, append a derived session_closed event + refresh state.md (crash-resilience). DERIVED-ONLY, fail-safe, never blocks.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Thing-denial KB (Muninn): on session end, materialise new command/decision-tribunal denials/defers into .ravenclaude/runs/thing/denial-kb.jsonl by reading the existing Sága audit records (hot-path-safe). No-op unless a comfort-posture exists; never writes stdout; always exits 0.
Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Session-context handoff nudge: advisory Stop additionalContext when context_handoff.mode is nag|block. Fail-open; never writes the brief; not a compact hook.

Marketplace-ONLY notification channel (deliberately NOT in any plugin hooks.json, so it never ships to consumers). Fires on the Claude Code Notification event and delivers the message to a sink: it ALWAYS appends a durable JSON line under .ravenclaude/runs/notifications/ (gitignored), and if RAVENCLAUDE_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK is set it also POSTs {"text":"<message>"} to that URL (Slack/Mattermost/Google-Chat-style incoming webhook). Fail-safe, always exits 0, never logs the webhook secret. This is the on-the-web / scheduled-routine egress that stands in for the managed PushNotification tool when it is absent in the environment.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Ask-on-ambiguity (ADVISORY, opt-in, fail-open): emits an additionalContext nudge when a prompt is short, names no file/path/symbol/quoted-string/number, AND pairs an open-ended verb with an unbound referent. NEVER blocks or alters the prompt (always exit 0). NO-EGRESS: writes no files and emits only fixed strings plus a derived word count. Disable with `ask_on_ambiguity: off`. It matches a SHAPE, not ambiguity, and cannot see whether the agent then actually asks.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Caveman auto-routing (FORGE P3 — SHADOW ONLY). No-ops (test -f + one anchored grep) unless .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml sets `caveman_routing: shadow|live` (absent/off => zero file writes). SHADOW is what "enabled" means in this phase: decide + record, NEVER call caveman-apply-mode.sh. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Agentic Work-Streams P4 (OPT-IN, FAIL-OPEN): no-ops unless .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml sets stream_hook: per_prompt (this repo doesn't, so it no-ops). When opted in, attributes the prompt to the active stream as a derived event (sticky — no reclassify) or auto-sets on a confident match. NEVER blocks/alters the prompt; NO-EGRESS (only derived labels persist).

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Agent-dispatch evaluator, Phase 3 — AUDIT-ONLY. No-ops (single grep) unless .ravenclaude/dispatch-config.json has enabled:true (this repo has none, so it no-ops). When opted in, shadow-logs a model-right-sizing verdict for the about-to-start subagent; it NEVER denies or redispatches (RM1 — SubagentStart fires post-spawn, deny-is-pre-commit unverified). The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; both paths are safe because the hook is fail-open and inert when dispatch-config is absent or disabled.

Marketplace-dev hook. Regenerates the comfort-posture project-layer rules from .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml at session start. No-ops in this repo because it has no .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; both paths are safe because the script is idempotent and no-ops when the posture file is absent.

Marketplace-dev hook. Warns when a session loads in acceptEdits/bypassPermissions mode, which bypasses the comfort-posture rules. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same hook for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; both paths are safe because the script is advisory and idempotent.

Marketplace-dev hook. Injects a session-start capability banner (project surface + detected auth by env-var NAME only + effective settings.json permissions + work-streams) via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. The only subprocess is a bounded read-only git read used by the streams classifier (gated on streams existing); the 10s timeout bounds any pathological read. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; both paths are safe because it is read-only, fail-silent, and emits nothing when there is nothing to report.

Marketplace-dev hook. Was MISSING from this dev-mirror while present in the plugin's hooks/hooks.json (found by Gate 259's hooks.json/settings.json SessionStart parity check, sessionstart-hook-safeguards FORGE run) -- meaning this repo's own dev sessions never got the sleep-assertion hook, even though the repo dogfoods other SessionStart hooks. OPT-IN via `keep_awake: on` in .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml; absent or off is a no-op after one grep. Never blocks; always exits 0. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json SessionStart entry). Worktree-hygiene guard (register): records this session's registry file under ${RC_WORKTREE_GUARD_HOME:-$HOME/.ravenclaude/worktree-guard} + GC-sweeps its bucket. Reads `worktree_guard: off|warn|block` from .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml (default warn; this repo dogfoods `worktree_guard: warn`). Nudges at SessionStart only on real contention (another live session in this same working tree) or anchor-work (primary checkout, worktrees exist, HEAD on the anchor branch); a lone checkout stays silent. `off` short-circuits before any git shell-out. Fail-open on missing git/jq; SessionStart cannot block. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Thing-denial KB (Muninn) recall: surfaces the most-recent tribunal-denial shapes + known resolutions via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Leak-safe (derived digest only); no-op unless a comfort-posture exists AND the KB is non-empty; always exits 0.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Dashboard autostart: reads `dashboard_autostart: off|serve|open` from .ravenclaude/comfort-posture.yaml and no-ops after one grep when unset (absent => OFF). Probes 127.0.0.1:<port>/__csrf and stands down if a dashboard is already live, so concurrent sessions never spawn a second server or a second tab. Fail-safe; always exits 0.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Caveman auto-routing (FORGE P3 — SHADOW ONLY), SessionStart half of the same hook body registered under UserPromptSubmit above. Joins this EXISTING startup|resume|clear|fork matcher group deliberately — no `compact` entry, no new matcher block. The plugin's hooks/hooks.json registers the same script for consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror). Handoff successor handshake: on startup, write successor-ack.json if a fresh pending marker exists. File write only.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Post-compaction addressability pointer, scoped `matcher: "compact"`. Injects the transcript path + boundary line + how to grep it — plus the newest PreCompact digest file for this session's run-dir, if precompact-digest.sh wrote one — so the post-compaction agent knows its own pre-compaction record is still on disk. DERIVED VALUES ONLY — never transcript or digest content (Gate 186). Fail-safe; always exits 0.

Marketplace-dev hook (dev-mirror of the plugin's hooks/hooks.json entry). Pre-compaction critical-info archive (P2, precompact-critical-context FORGE plan). Reads the PreCompact payload's optional `transcript_path` and, if present, calls scripts/precompact-digest.py to write a curated digest to .ravenclaude/runs/<session>/precompact-digest-<timestamp>.md BEFORE the transcript is summarized away. Fire-and-forget, archival only — never gating; deliberately never exits non-zero (PreCompact CAN block on Claude Code via exit 2, and this hook never does). Same script the plugin distributes to consumers via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
